summary: Iteration 8 tested: bulk-delete/mine backend endpoints + frontend Suara Kasir sound toggle, Riwayat Kasir card, and Kelola Voucher bulk select/print/delete. All backend (5/5) and frontend flows pass. AudioContext + window.print stubbed via init script; oscillator counts and print calls verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py my_redemptions_today: start-of-day computation subtracts 7h from UTC midnight to approximate WIB day boundary; correct behaviour depends on server tz assumptions. Consider computing WIB day explicitly (UTC+7) to avoid drift.
bulk-delete accepts any 24-hex ObjectId even if not owned; fine for single-tenant admin app but no logging of deleted codes.
VoucherManagement.js is ~500 lines and growing; consider splitting bulk actions and print-template into subcomponents.
useSound: singleton ctx across hook instances is fine, but AudioContext creation on module scope would fail SSR; current lazy init is OK.
test_credentials: Admin/123456 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Temp kasir created and deleted per module fixture.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 vouchers (prefix FB) via UI-driven fetch; all deleted at end. Backend tests create/delete their own vouchers with prefixes BD/KF/MR.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration8.py covers bulk-delete + /redemptions/mine. FE stubs AudioContext with page.add_init_script and monkey-patches window.print. localStorage key voucherku_sound persists ('on'/'off').
